> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-06-18

# Summary
Arizona version of the outdoor faucet (hose bib) leak post: common causes in summer heat, safe DIY fixes, and when to call a plumber. Published 2026-06-18 at `/blog/outdoor-faucet-leaking/` (ID 5783).

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: outdoor faucet leaking. SEO title (56 chars): "Outdoor Faucet Leaking? Causes and Fixes for AZ Homes".
- Links: fixture installation Chandler (money page), water leak detection Chandler, sibling hidden-leak post, contact. Reciprocal link to `/blog/water-pressure-too-high-prv/` held until that post went live (target 21 Aug 2026).
- External sources: an InspectAPedia page on anti-siphon sillcocks and USGS hardness of water.
- All winter freeze, frost-free sillcock and "drain before winter" content from the Utah original was removed; season framed as Arizona summer watering.

# Utah flag
- Utah original at `blogs\_utah_originals\outdoor-faucet-leaking.md` (title "Causes and Fixes for Utah").
- Featured image filename `outdoor-faucet-leaking-utah-hose-bib.png` kept; alt text says Chandler, Arizona.
